public_rationale: Marcus said hallucinations frequently show up in AI agents. Anthropic's report on its shop-running agent (spring 2025) documents several fabrications. The agent invented a person named Sarah, a Venmo account, and a meeting with security. In July 2025, Ars Technica reported two separate coding agents, Google's Gemini CLI and Replit, that confabulated operations that never happened. Replit's agent also produced fake data and false test results. These are repeated, documented cases across several vendors in the months before the post, which fits the plain reading of 'frequently'.
limitations: No standard rate measure; 'frequently' is judged from repeated documented cases.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Hallucinations frequently occur in AI agents.

statement.document_title: AI Agents have, so far, mostly been a dud

our_interpretation: He names no period. I read it as describing AI agents in 2025 up to the post date (2025-08-03).
Plain reading: in 2025, fabricated information (made-up facts, people, accounts, or system states) was a recurring, well-documented failure of deployed or tested AI agents, not a rare one-off.
criteria.support_condition: Several documented 2025 agent deployments or tests show agents making up facts, people, accounts, or results.
criteria.contradiction_condition: 2025 agent evaluations and deployment reports show fabrication to be rare or negligible.

evidence.excerpt: On the afternoon of March 31st, Claudius hallucinated a conversation about restocking plans with someone named Sarah at Andon Labs—despite there being no such person.
evidence.explanation: Anthropic's own report on its shop-running agent describes it inventing a person and a conversation. The same report lists a hallucinated Venmo account and a hallucinated meeting with security.

evidence.excerpt: The core issue appears to be what researchers call “confabulation” or “hallucination”—when AI models generate plausible-sounding but false information. In these cases, both models confabulated successful operations and built subsequent actions on those false premises.
evidence.explanation: Two separate coding agents from different companies (Google Gemini CLI and Replit) hallucinated in July 2025. The article also says Replit created fake data and false test results.
